title: In vivo imaging of Ras protein’s activity in olfactory neurons
protocol: Pick up individual adult animals expressing Raichu-Ras probe to a bacteria-free NGM plate to remove bacteria.
Pick up the animal and put them on a 4% agarose pad made on a cover glass.
Immobilize the animal on the agarose pad by glue delivered through a drawn glass capillary tube, keeping the tip of the animal’s head free from glue.
Place the cover glass with glued animal in a 35 mm laboratory dish and cover with 4 ml imaging buffer solution.

Capture images of the cell body of the olfactory neuron expressing the probe using a microscope equipped with a 40× or 63× objective lens and a digital camera device, maintaining room temperature at 20-23°C during imaging analysis.
Add 20 μl odorants solution to the buffer covering animals using pipetman as the odorant stimuli for stimulation.
Exclude crosstalk between the YFP and CFP emission spectra using a linear unmixing method to distinguish weak signals representing Ras activity from noise (optional).
Calculate fluorescent intensity using imaging software.
